## Disposition

Accept the partial nonvanishing results for 30000323 / OWR-1063-006 and the complete independent audit without substantive mathematical correction. The general MSTOP_(p) target and even the displayed Euler class e(W) remain unresolved after 5/5 approaches. No sixth approach, full solution, target counterexample, novelty claim or worldwide-openness certificate is added.

The target is the canonical MU -> MSO -> MSTOP -> MSTOP_(p) complex orientation and Borel Euler classes of finite abelian odd-p groups. Accepted sufficient conditions are a nonzero mod-p first Chern class for every character, a cyclic element avoiding every kernel, dimension <= p, and reciprocal-order sum <= 1. The normalized KU orientation comparison uses an actual invertible factor formed on CP infinity and pulled back to BG. The zero-dimensional representation has unit Euler class.

The (p+1)-dimensional W over C_(p^2) x C_p defeats ordinary cohomology, K-theory and all proper-subgroup restrictions; none of these failures evaluates its MSTOP Euler class. The formal expression and p-series relations do not assert an injective/surjective quotient presentation; all completion/derived-term qualifications remain. The exotic-map Sullivan splitting is not a natural orientation-compatible detecting retraction. Universal nonvanishing needs nonnilpotence, not merely nonzero, of the full Euler product.

Read the unchanged current/RESULT.md and complete current/AUDIT_REPORT.md. The original authored proofs, original finite verifier, independent verifier and seven source-mutation checks are unchanged. Selected historical receipts and public source metadata are labeled as historical. The inspected full Hanke-Puppe paper is arXiv:math/0301279v1; published-version equivalence and independent tom Dieck proof replay are not claimed.

## Reproduction and boundaries

Every mode reruns 3,135 original character subsets and 11,632 independent multisets: 11,302 reciprocal-order cases, 8,498 mod-p-detected multisets and 16 kernel-cover multisets. The independent tests check W for p=3,5,7,11,13 and all proper subgroups for p=3,5,7. Seven source mutants are rejected with fixed reasons (six finite arithmetic/representation errors and one prime-domain failure). These are separately accounted from publication integrity/schema/comparator controls. Finite algebra does not compute MSTOP, prove source topological constructions, or certify novelty.

Authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py against the external SHA-256 below, copy that authenticated file outside the packet, set packet files to 0444 and directories to 0555, then use actual UID=EUID=1000:

- python -I -S -B /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -O /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -OO /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet

Every stdout/stderr byte must match its authenticated mode-specific reference without normalization. Recursive exact types, identities/counts, changed/empty/skipped/expected-failure outputs, physical create/append/unlink denials, hostile imports and before/after whole-packet hashes are checked. The trusted runtime is CPython 3.12.14; other interpreters must still satisfy the exact raw contracts. Permission modes prevent accidental writes, not owner chmod or root access.

The manifest binds every delivered byte except itself and BOOTSTRAP.py; the externally pinned bootstrap binds the manifest and both executable harnesses. All included historical/pre-seal receipts are covered. Final external replay receipts remain outside the inventory to avoid circular hashes. Historical harness, source bodies, tom Dieck original, published Hanke-Puppe version, new source search, dataset, formal proof assistant and MSTOP cohomology replays are NOT_RUN.

Only the target attempt directory is added. No QUEUE or unrelated path changes. Source bodies, datasets, private sources, private coordination and identifying metadata for excluded private files are excluded.
